profile.headline: Senior Web Developer | Problem Solver
profile.summary: Experienced Frond-end Web Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in HTML, CSS, Wordpress, PHP, Javascript, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Photoshop. Strong media and communication professional with a Bachelors Degree focused in Multimedia Studies: FVNM from Florida Atlantic University.

positions.locationName: Pompano Beach, Florida, United States · On-site

positions.title: Director of Web Development
positions.description: Promoted to a senior developer position where I directed, strategized, and implemented web development practices for a digital agency. Helped develop websites across multiple platforms including Wordpress, Shopify, Shopify Plus, Webflow, and Joomla. Led successful and efficient development campaigns while nurturing positive relationships with clients.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed, created, and modified websites using responsive techniques. Translated static PSD and XD design layouts into dynamic pixel-perfect web/mobile interfaces while keeping the intended creative integrity. Worked closely with designers and clients to translate visual designs into dynamic functional interfaces for web and mobile projects. Built e-commerce platforms for clients and set up SEO and analytics dashboards to go along. All while keeping up-to-date with the latest web development trends.

positions.title: Web Producer
positions.description: Transferred to Silver Hill Funding, a subsidiary of Bayview Asset Management, to lead web development and email marketing campaigns. Worked directly with Salesforce and Pardot Marketing Automation to deliver landing pages and email campaigns to database of brokers.

positions.title: Associate Web Producer
positions.description: Web and digital marketing for an in-house shared agency. Created websites, landing pages, email templates, and more. Handled SEO and Reporting analytics platform. . Sent blast emails up to 5 times a week. Managed database within IBM Watson Marketing Cloud to query lists for blast emails. Lead redesigns of company websites on WordPress platform.

positions.title: Web and Graphic Designer
positions.description: Built company websites and maintained company landing pages. Produced marketing videos for advertising. Controlled email marketing which lead to generating leads.
